card.name: The word for after injectable drug names
card.fires_on: Mainly the word "for" right after a drug name and before "Injection" (e.g. "topotecan hydrochloride for injection"). Also weaker on "by" or "single" just before a route or dose-form word.

modes.label: "for" in drug product names
modes.description: The word "for" between a drug name and "injection" in lyophilized-powder product names.
modes.example: Topotecan Hydrochloride<< for>> Injection is contraindicated in patients

modes.label: Route or dose linking words
modes.description: "by" or "single" after a dose, just before subcutaneous or intravenous delivery wording.
modes.example: XOLAIR 150 mg or 300 mg<< by>> subcutaneous injection every 4 weeks

card.writes: It pushes down word starts like admin and administer, so it steers the next word away from those.
card.plain: It marks the little word "for" in names like "drug X for injection", where the next word is expected to be injection.
